symptom: Repair v14 passed the candidate static chain, GameCore validate-content, and isolated validate-candidates. Idle, Random, Coward, Kite, Tank, BossHunter, ZoneControl, and Route stayed inside their target bands, but GreedyXpBot remained at 0.0%, below the 25%-55% mid-skill target. The Greedy failures still clustered around 225-229 seconds at levels 8-10.
root_cause: v14 increased sprinkle-spitter XP from 5 to 6 and score from 16 to 18 while keeping v13 projectile timing. The Greedy result did not move, so the narrow reward-threshold hypothesis is rejected. The likely issue is that the 210-300 second ranged-pressure lane is changing Greedy's route risk or pickup path rather than simply leaving it short of one upgrade.
fix: Do not promote v14 or run the 10-seed expansion. The next repair should decouple Coward recovery from Greedy bait: keep low-skill recovery available, but avoid placing that recovery primarily on a ranged pressure enemy that Greedy chases into the 225-229 second failure window. Investigate v13/v14 Greedy representative replays and test a v15 candidate that shifts recovery toward safer XP sources or adjusts the 210-300 second frosting-grassland route pressure, without weakening the player weapon/passive package.
validation: Create v15 as a generated candidate only, rerun the full candidate static chain, then rerun the same 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. Passing requires CowardBot 10%-35%, GreedyXpBot 25%-55%, RouteBot 10%-35%, and all other bots remaining in their configured target bands before any 10-seed expansion.
